title: Prahlad, the boy who was never afraid.
lines: This is an old story from India.
It's about the festival of Holi.
Long ago there was a king.
The king had been granted a wish.
No human and no animal could hurt him.
Not in the daytime and not at night.
The king thought: Now I'm the most important of all.
They did what the king said.
But the king had a little son.
Every day he sang songs for Vishnu.
You must pray to me, not to Vishnu!
Prahlad said kindly: Daddy, I love you.
In the sky, in the trees, in you and in me.
And every time he was protected.
With that shawl, fire couldn't touch her.
Holika said: I'll take Prahlad on my lap.
In the middle of a big fire.
And then Prahlad will surely be scared.
They made a big pile of wood.
He sang his song for Vishnu.
The shawl flew off Holika's shoulders.
And the shawl fell around Prahlad.
He stepped out of the fire.
But Holika didn't have the shawl anymore.
At the moment when it was neither day nor night.
That's how Vishnu put an end to the wicked king.
He was kind and fair to everyone.
And that's why every year in India people light a big fire.
And the next day they throw colours.
